answer: A fresh clone arrives at the lagoon edge with no sealed grading history, and weight only climbs the terrace of trust one quorum-matched verdict at a time, each re-checked on-ledger against consensus. No reputation spirals outward onto a sibling key: it cannot be minted, bought, or handed over. A swarm of M fakes must each grade its own slow way up the terrace, so the sybil bill rises linearly with identities and never amortizes across the pool.
